items.rationale: ROUND(D2,-1) gives a price ending in 0 and subtracting 1 makes it end in 9. Subtracting first and then rounding ends in 0 again. Adding 1 ends in 1. ROUND with 0 digits keeps odd units, so the price does not end in 9.
2,287 rounds to the nearest 10 as 2,290. Subtracting 1 gives 2,289.
1,850 times 0.9 is 1,665. A value exactly halfway between 1,660 and 1,670 rounds up to 1,670, and subtracting 1 gives 1,669.
Column E uses column D and column F uses column E, so a change in B7 flows through the whole chain. This is why the discount sits in one input cell.
